verdict.rationale: Copilot documents assigning tasks to multiple agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex) that run autonomously in the background. It also documents tracking progress across agents and reviewing and merging their work from one workspace, so parallel agent sessions are supported. Nothing shows launching several attempts at the same task or comparing them side by side to pick a winner. Missing for 10: explicit best-of-N attempts on one task, a side-by-side comparison of results, a documented select-one workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
track progress across multiple agents, review changes, and merge completed work—all from one desktop workspace built natively on GitHub.
Use one centralized control page to jump between agent sessions, check progress, and stay in control without losing your place.
